originalTitle: Oil rises amid supply disruption fears following Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz
summary: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.
content:
Oil rose Friday amid worries over supply disruptions after Iran published a restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz .

Futures for international benchmark Brent crude for October delivery gained 1.22% to $83.50 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures for September advanced 1.11% at $78.15 per barrel.

"Higher oil prices signaled that a further inflationary impulse from energy and the situation in the Middle East could not be discounted, sending US dollar higher and government bonds lower," Westpac said in a note.

According to the apparent draft plan published by Iran, the country would ban U.S. and Israeli ships from transiting the Strait. Until compensation is paid, other nations that have harmed Iran would not be allowed to transit, according to the draft.

While Iran and Oman are reportedly working on an agreement to define transit routes in the Hormuz strait, a deal still has not been announced. According to media reports, inbound traffic would transit Iranian waters while outbound traffic would go through Omani waters.

"Adding to supply concerns, Ukraine struck two of Russia's major oil refineries overnight (Yaroslavl/Yanos and Bashneft's Novoil facility), and US imports of Saudi crude dropped to zero in July for the first time since 1985," according to a note by UOB.

Meanwhile, U.S. President Donald Trump said in the Oval Office in a reference to Iran that he thinks the war in Iran will end "pretty soon."
chineseTitle: 伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的限制性草案计划引发供应中断担忧，油价上涨
chineseSummary: 伊朗针对霍尔木兹海峡的限制性草案计划的消息推高了油价，再次引发了对供应中断的担忧。
chineseContent:
伊朗公布霍尔木兹海峡限制性计划草案后，由于担心供应中断，周五油价上涨。

10 月交割的国际基准布伦特原油期货上涨 1.22%，至每桶 83.50 美元。美国西德克萨斯中质原油 9 月期货上涨 1.11%，至每桶 78.15 美元。

西太平洋银行在一份报告中表示：“油价上涨表明，能源和中东局势带来的进一步通胀冲动不容忽视，导致美元走高，政府债券走低。”

根据伊朗公布的明显计划草案，该国将禁止美国和以色列船只通过该海峡。根据草案，在支付赔偿之前，其他伤害伊朗的国家将不被允许过境。

据报道，伊朗和阿曼正在制定一项协议，确定霍尔木兹海峡的过境路线，但协议尚未公布。据媒体报道，入境流量将经过伊朗水域，出境流量将经过阿曼水域。

大华银行的一份报告称，“乌克兰隔夜袭击了俄罗斯的两家主要炼油厂（雅罗斯拉夫尔/亚诺斯和 Bashneft 的 Novoil 设施），这加剧了供应方面的担忧，7 月份美国对沙特原油的进口自 1985 年以来首次降至零”。

与此同时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在椭圆形办公室谈到伊朗时表示，他认为伊朗战争将“很快”结束。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
